name: FoldedPaperHeadline
job: A headline printed across a zig-zag folded paper strip that opens flat as the visitor scrolls, letters straightening with each crease
visitor_action: scroll to unfold; readable at every stage
mobile: fewer folds, unfolds on view instead of scroll
motion: facets rotate to flat with perspective and eased settle (reduced-motion: flat open strip)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Origami studio: coral-red folded stock, cream type, sharp light and shadow planes on each facet, matte paper grain
notes: 2026-11-24: broken-fix pass. Replaced the scroll-mapped unfold with an in-view trigger (opens when comfortably on screen or fully visible at page end, folds back after leaving). Also fixed: strip had no height (text clipped to a ~50px bar) - an invisible sizer now gives the real headline height so long text wraps to 2-3 lines, then shrinks, never clips; facets are now one facet wide each (the chain was k times too wide); lead facet rotation was missing, and the --cx crease angles lacked the deg unit so every mid-unfold frame lost its crease transforms. Checked headless folded / unfolded at 1280, 375, worst.
